fullPassage: Inevitably, the world of electoral systems is crowded and complex and becoming more so all the time: one country's electoral system is never the same as another's (although in some cases the differences are quite small). Given the range of variations among the different electoral systems, this makes life quite difficult for the analyst seeking to produce an acceptable typology. One option might be to simply base a classification of the systems in terms of their outputs, that is, with reference to the process of translating votes into seats where one distinguishes between those systems which have 'proportional' outcomes and those with 'non-proportional' outcomes. The essence of proportional systems is to ensure that the number of seats each party wins reflects as closely as possible the number of votes it has received. In non-proportional systems, by contrast, greater importance is attached to ensuring that one party has a clear majority of seats over its competitors, thereby (hopefully) increasing the prospect of a strong and stable government.

❌ ② 2문장에 'this makes life quite difficult for the analyst'라고 했으므로 '간단하다'와 정반대
✅ ③ 5문장에 비례 시스템의 핵심이 의석 수가 득표 수를 밀접하게 반영하도록 보장하는 것이라고 일치
❌ ④ 마지막 문장에 비비례 시스템은 한 정당의 '명확한 다수 의석(clear majority)'을 목표로 한다고 했으므로 '비례성'과 반대

questions.passage: Inevitably, the world of electoral systems is crowded and complex and becoming more so all the time: one country's electoral system is never the same as another's (although in some cases the differences are quite small). Given the range of variations among the different electoral systems, this makes life quite difficult for the analyst seeking to produce an acceptable typology. One option might be to simply base a classification of the systems in terms of their outputs, that is, with reference to the process of translating votes into seats where one distinguishes between those systems which have 'proportional' outcomes and those with 'non-proportional' outcomes. The essence of proportional systems is to ensure that the number of seats each party wins reflects as closely as possible the number of votes it has received. In non-proportional systems, by contrast, greater importance is attached to ensuring that one party has a clear majority of seats over its competitors, thereby (hopefully) increasing the prospect of a strong and stable government.

det.korean: 1문장에 'one country's electoral system is never the same as another's'라고 했으므로, 동일성이 전제된다는 것은 본문과 정반대입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 1문장 '(although in some cases the differences are quite small)'과 일치
✅ ② 3~4문장에 결과물 기준 분류가 비례/비비례 결과를 구분한다고 일치
✅ ③ 마지막 문장에 비비례 시스템이 '강하고 안정적인 정부의 전망을 높인다(increasing the prospect of a strong and stable government)'고 일치

det.tip: never the same(결코 동일하지 않다)는 강한 부정입니다. 유형 분류(typology)가 어려운 이유가 바로 이 다양성 때문입니다.

det.korean: 선거제도들 사이에 다양성(variations)이 존재하기 때문에 분류가 어렵다는 것이 원문의 논리이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① complex(복잡한): 선거제도가 '복잡하다'는 문맥에서 적절
❌ ② uniformity(균일성) → variations(다양성): 본문은 '다양한 선거제도들 간의 차이(variations among the different electoral systems)' 때문에 분류가 어렵다고 했음. '균일성(uniformity)'으로 바꾸면 모두 같다는 의미가 되어 분류가 어렵다는 결론과 모순
✅ ③ acceptable(수용 가능한): '수용 가능한 유형 분류(acceptable typology)'라는 문맥에서 적절
✅ ④ outputs(결과물): '결과물(outputs) 기준으로 분류한다'는 기술적 문맥에서 적절
det.tip: variations(다양성/변형)은 여러 형태가 존재함을, uniformity(균일성)는 모두 같음을 의미합니다. 다양하기 때문에 분류가 어렵다는 논리를 파악하세요.

❌ ④ 국제적 기준이나 합의 과정에 대한 논의는 본문에 없음

det.korean: 득표 수를 가능한 한 밀접하게 반영하는 것
